items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Al Gibson, he wasn't there then. So Hilton Jefferson on alto; Andrew Brown on the second alto; Walter Thomas on the other tenor... I think Jerry Blake... Four saxophones, right?

ctx.x: We had another guy on baritone. I can't think of his name now.

Oh, I know. ..[INAUDIBLE NAME]..... But he wasn't there. Al Gibson, he wasn't there then. So Hilton Jefferson on alto; Andrew Brown on the second alto; Walter Thomas on the other tenor... I think Jerry Blake... Four saxophones, right?
Eddie Barefield was in there, wasn't he?
